prompt: Write a loop that sums every multiple of 3 or 5 below a limit. Complete the sumOfMultiples method in the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: A counting for loop visits every number below the limit; the % (remainder) operator tests divisibility. Using || means a number divisible by both 3 and 5 still passes the condition exactly once, so it is only added once. An accumulator variable declared before the loop collects the running total.
hints: Use a for loop that counts i from 1 up to (but not including) limit.
i % 3 == 0 is true exactly when i is a multiple of 3. Combine two of these tests with ||.
Declare int sum = 0 before the loop and add qualifying values of i to it inside the loop.
